Subject: Redwood onboarding bootcamp — team availability

Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team found it really helpful. We want to do a hands-on bootcamp next week for our infra and app teams to accelerate our pilot. Proposed goals: 1) Console walkthrough + org setup, 2) API integration patterns and sample code, 3) Q&A / next steps.

Attendees will include engineering (4), platform (2), and our security lead (1). Prefer weekday mornings ET. Do you have a 2.5–3 hour slot available next Tuesday or Wednesday? Attached is a short internal agenda so you can tailor the session.

Best,
Tom

Director of Engineering, Finova
[Attachment: finova_onboard_agenda.pdf (PDF)]

Tom — great to hear and thanks for the context. We can run a single 3-hr bootcamp or split into two 90-min modules (Console + API). For productively onboarding multiple teams I usually recommend the split — keeps people focused and lets us record the API deep-dive for engineers who can't attend.

Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue 2026-10-13 10:00–11:30 (Console) + 13:00–14:30 (API)
- Wed 2026-10-14 09:30–11:00 (Console) + 12:30–14:00 (API)

If any of those look close, pick one and I’ll send calendar invites. Alternatively you can pick a time directly on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marcus-redwood/api-bootcamp-60

Attachments: I’ve attached a proposed agenda that maps to the goals you shared and includes prep steps for your security lead (short checklist).

Looking forward — Marcus
